en: The front image features two men in military uniforms seated in a worn, possibly makeshift office with a rough, peeling wall in the background and some photos or documents stuck to it. One man sits at a desk covered by a white cloth, while the other sits on a bench, facing forward, both posing for the camera. The reverse side shows handwritten German text, a date (12.9.17), a Feldpost (military mail) stamp, and the address written in elegant script.
